assertions.description: WebTransport.prototype exposes getStats as a function.
getStats() on a real (never-connecting) session returns a Promise.
assertions.test: (()=>{if(typeof WebTransport!=='function'||typeof WebTransport.prototype.getStats!=='function')return false;const t=new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never');t.closed.catch(()=>{});t.ready.catch(()=>{});const r=t.getStats();const ok=r instanceof Promise;if(ok)r.catch(()=>{});try{t.close();}catch(e){}return ok;})()

assertions.description: A settled stats dictionary carries the datagram ledger: datagrams.expiredOutgoing, datagrams.droppedIncoming and datagrams.lostOutgoing are numbers.
assertions.test: (async()=>{if(typeof WebTransport!=='function'||typeof WebTransport.prototype.getStats!=='function')return false;const t=new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never');t.ready.catch(()=>{});try{await t.closed;}catch(e){}let s;try{s=await Promise.race([t.getStats(),new Promise((_,rej)=>setTimeout(()=>rej(new Error('timeout')),2000))]);}catch(e){return false;}const d=s&&s.datagrams;return !!d&&typeof d.expiredOutgoing==='number'&&typeof d.droppedIncoming==='number'&&typeof d.lostOutgoing==='number';})()

assertions.description: When present, the RTT members (minRtt, smoothedRtt, rttVariation) are numbers, and estimatedSendRate is a number or null — never a bucketed string.
assertions.test: (async()=>{if(typeof WebTransport!=='function'||typeof WebTransport.prototype.getStats!=='function')return false;const t=new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never');t.ready.catch(()=>{});try{await t.closed;}catch(e){}let s;try{s=await Promise.race([t.getStats(),new Promise((_,rej)=>setTimeout(()=>rej(new Error('timeout')),2000))]);}catch(e){return false;}const numOrAbsent=(v)=>v===undefined||typeof v==='number';return numOrAbsent(s.minRtt)&&numOrAbsent(s.smoothedRtt)&&numOrAbsent(s.rttVariation)&&(s.estimatedSendRate===null||numOrAbsent(s.estimatedSendRate));})()

assertions.description: Statistics remain accessible after the connection closes: getStats() still settles with a dictionary on a session whose closed promise has already rejected.
assertions.test: (async()=>{if(typeof WebTransport!=='function'||typeof WebTransport.prototype.getStats!=='function')return false;const t=new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never');t.ready.catch(()=>{});try{await t.closed;}catch(e){}try{const s=await Promise.race([t.getStats(),new Promise((_,rej)=>setTimeout(()=>rej(new Error('timeout')),2000))]);return !!s&&typeof s==='object';}catch(e){return false;}})()
